as_told.title: UFO phenomenon core as time-traveling humans

plain: The theory says UFOs are not aliens at all but humans from the future, travelling back in time. It belongs to Mike Masters, whom Michels introduces as an evolutionary biologist at Montana Tech, a university in Montana, and the author of books including Identified Flying Objects and another Michels calls Extempore. Michels brings Masters up while talking with Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon official, and asks whether he knows the work. A researcher and author named Eric Wargo picks up the idea on a later episode. He says the real core of the phenomenon "very likely involves" time-travelling humans. If true, the beings people report would be our own descendants coming back to look at us.
